page0.text:
Fools rush in where angels fear to tread.
No matter how pretty she is, Rider reeks of blood.
That alone should be enough to keep me on my guard.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-04:page0:1

page1.text:
Well, and...
I really don't know where to look, so talking to her is really not a priority.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-04:page1:1

page2.text:
"...What is it?"
"Guh...!"
I quickly avert my gaze.
"N-nothing! Th-thanks for seeing me off!"
I start running to get away as fast as possible.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート六日目-04:page2:1
